title: Solar Inverter Offline Watch
dataSources: Sharing activity (`sustain:share`), repairs (`sustain:repair`), compost logs (`sustain:compost`), solar telemetry (`sustain:solar`), sustainability audits (`sustain:audit`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — Olio sharing activity, Repair Cafe repair logs, compost-weight records, and solar-offset telemetry — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and smart-home integrations.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sustain:solar inverter_name=* offline_flag=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(offline_flag="yes",1,0))) as matched by inverter_name
| eval an_offline_interval_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_offline_interval_pct
description: Measures the percentage of solar telemetry intervals that end with an offline interval by inverter.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which inverter are helping or hurting solar telemetry intervals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an offline interval` on `sustain:solar` events and summarize the hit rate by `inverter_name`.
visualization: Table of inverter with percentage of solar telemetry intervals ending with an offline interval.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how often an offline interval happens for each inverter so you can see where solar telemetry intervals go smoothly or get stuck.
